verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸੀਂਚਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naanaa misaTaan paan bahu bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh see(n)chat sarab ras rasanaa kahaiee hai ||

en.bdb: Tongue that enjoys many forms of sweet and savoury foods, drinks and is relisher of all the tastes is called gustation. Eyes see good and bad, beautiful and ugly and is therefore known as vision power.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਅਮਿਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat liv giaan dhiaan simaran amit baddaiee hai ||

en.bdb: Ears for their ability to hear all sorts of sounds, melodies etc. are called hearing power. With the use of all these faculties, one obtains knowledge of various things, focuses one's mind in meaningful thoughts and earns worldly respect.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਕਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਅਉ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sakal surat asaparas aau raag naadh budh bal bachan bibek Tek paiee hai ||

en.bdb: The skin brings awareness of things through touch. Enjoyment of music and songs, intellect, strength, speech and dependence on discrimination is the boon of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਬੋਲਤ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat satinaam simarat safal hui bolat madhur dhun sun sukhadhaiee hai ||13||

en.bdb: But all these senses of knowledge are useful if a person obtains the boon of Guru's wisdom, dwells his mind in the name of the Immortal Lord and sings the sweet paeans of me Lord's name. Such tune and melody of His name is bestower of bliss and happiness. (13)
